title: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting memory for knowledge retention
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout, access restrictions, licensing prerequisites and automation are supported by Microsoft's records and documentation. The retention path correctly reaches the policy wizard but should continue to its configuration pages; the expanded preview-program name also needs its supporting citation.

claims.claim: Meeting-memory generation is controlled in Teams admin center under Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting memory.
claims.quote: Admins can change this setting in the Teams Admin Center: 1. Go to Meetings > Meeting policies. 2. Find the Meeting memory setting.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy supports -Identity, Boolean -AllowMeetingKnowledgeGeneration and -KnowledgeGenerationMeetingTypes AllMeetings, TranscribedMeetings or None for memory generation.
claims.quote: AllMeetings: Allow generation for all meetings, including meetings without transcription. TranscribedMeetings: Allow generation only for meetings with transcription. None: Do not generate meeting knowledge files.

claims.claim: The AllowMeetingKnowledgeGeneration reference warns that the setting has no effect until the feature is released.
claims.quote: This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect.

claims.claim: KnowledgeGenerationMeetingTypes applies only with AllowIntelligentRecap and AllowMeetingKnowledgeGeneration both true.
claims.quote: This setting applies only when both AllowIntelligentRecap and AllowMeetingKnowledgeGeneration are set to $True.

claims.claim: The memory-generation meeting policy is assigned at user scope.
claims.quote: Specifies which meetings organized by users assigned this policy can generate an AI-generated meeting knowledge file.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no admin UI for deleting a meeting's memory.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams meeting memory delete remove admin center UI expiration setting navigation path; read Memory for Microsoft Teams Meetings and search excerpts. Deletion UI is organizer-side Delete recap content; admin deletion is documented through PowerShell only.

claims.claim: Remove-AIGeneratedKnowledge -ThreadId <id> deletes memory for the specified meeting.
claims.quote: A Microsoft Teams admin can also delete a meeting memory file through PowerShell: ... Run the following command (ThreadId is required; CallId is optional) Remove-AIGeneratedKnowledge -ThreadId <String> -CallId <String>

claims.claim: The Copilot control is in Teams admin center under Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Copilot.
claims.quote: go to Meetings > Meeting policies. 2. Select an existing policy or create a new one. 3. Go to the Recording & transcription section and find the Copilot setting.

claims.quote: ### -Copilot ... Possible values are: - Enabled - EnabledWithTranscript

claims.claim: Copilot meeting policies can be assigned to individual users.

claims.fix: Extend controls[3].ui.path and the rendered path to 'Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy > Assign admin units > Full directory > Choose the type of retention policy to create > Static > Choose locations > SharePoint classic and communication sites > Decide if you want to retain content, delete it, or both'. claims.claim: New-RetentionComplianceRule -Name <rule> -Policy <existing-policy> -RetentionDuration <days> -RetentionComplianceAction <Keep|Delete|KeepAndDelete> configures a retention rule.
claims.quote: New-RetentionComplianceRule -Name SeptOneYear -Policy "Internal Company Policy" -RetentionDuration 365 -RetentionComplianceAction KeepAndDelete -ExpirationDateOption ModificationAgeInDays

claims.claim: Purview retention policies govern tenant memory containers.
claims.quote: Retention policies on memory files are managed in the Purview Data lifecycle management tool. Meeting memory sites included in SharePoint classic and communication sites

claims.claim: The retention wizard instructs admins to keep Full directory on Assign admin units.
claims.quote: For the Assign admin units page, keep the default of Full directory. Currently, admin units aren't supported for this policy.

claims.claim: Static is a documented retention-policy type that permits choosing locations and inclusions.
claims.quote: If you chose Static: On the Choose locations page, toggle on or off any of the locations except the locations for Teams and Viva Engage.

claims.claim: SharePoint classic and communication sites is the retention location covering meeting-memory sites.
claims.quote: Meeting memory sites included in SharePoint classic and communication sites, so no other configuration is needed to target memory files with the same retention policy as other SharePoint content.

claims.claim: A different retention policy for memory can be scoped by including its container URLs.
claims.quote: To target memory with a different policy, you can use the include or exclude settings to scope your search to your meeting memory container URLs.

claims.claim: The rule must be added to an existing retention policy.
claims.quote: The retention rule must be added to an existing retention policy using the Policy parameter.

claims.claim: The retention cmdlets are available in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

claims.claim: Get-AIGeneratedKnowledgeContainer retrieves the memory container URL using a required ThreadId, with CallId optional as for removal.
claims.quote: A specific memory file container URL can be found by the Teams admin through PowerShell: ... Run the following command (ThreadId is required; CallId is optional). Get-AIGeneratedKnowledgeContainer -ThreadId <String> -CallId <String>

claims.claim: Turning off intelligent recap in a meeting's options stops memory generation for that meeting.
claims.quote: Memory generation can be turned off for a specific meeting by turning off Intelligent Recap in the meeting options.

claims.claim: Creating a retention policy requires at least one location parameter, so an unscoped policy does not enforce retention.
claims.quote: Policies are not valid until a rule is added (for retention policies) or a label is added (for retention label policies). ... In addition, at least one location parameter must be defined to create a retention policy or retention label policy.

claims.claim: A retention policy is not valid until a rule is added.
claims.quote: Policies are not valid until a rule is added (for retention policies) or a label is added (for retention label policies).
